fields.label: Classification
fields.description: Where these shares go. SiT = P&L treatment on sale; Investment = LTCG/STCG via Capital Gains.

fields.label: Qty
fields.description: Number of shares being assigned to this classification. Must come from the parent Holding's Unclassified pool.

fields.label: Classified On
fields.description: Auto-set to insert time. Immutable after first save.

fields.label: Classified By
fields.description: User who classified. 'Administrator' for auto-classified rows (day-5 scheduler).

fields.label: Auto-Classified
fields.description: Set when the day-5 scheduler classified the remaining Unclassified portion as Stock in Trade automatically.
